items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: A fellow named Joe Williams. He said, oh David, come to the window quick... He got me excited. What's the matter? He said, you know Willie Joe got killed?

ctx.x: He went to California during the war, right? In the fall.

Well anyhow, he was in California. Come back here to visit the people. They're only here a month. And this car hit him about 2 o'clock on a Saturday evening. Hit him at 4th Street and carried him all the way to the club. And didn't stop. Never stopped. Didn't catch that guy until about one or two weeks after that. Hit him. Hit him. Hit him. Hit him. Hit him. Run drive. And the fellow told me about it. I live on Chippewa Street upstairs. A fellow named Joe Williams. He said, oh David, come to the window quick.…

Oh. But this fellow, I know you know him. He plays a guitar player. He worked at the quarters sometimes. He plays, he's still one of the banjo players. George, his name is George something. Kind of heavy built up brown skin fellow with a sort of large hair. And he plays the- Oh, Lawrence Marrero. No, his name is George. George Gano. I don't know his last name. Pre-old George. Pre-old George. Yeah. With those Bush-Countdowns, the government all the way across. Yeah. I played one of my first carnival jobs with him.…
